fullContentHtml:
UPSC Engineering Services Pre Online Form 2027 – Full Details

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the notification for the post of Engineering Service Examination 2027 on the official website. This recruitment was released for 480 posts. The online application process for UPSC Engineering Services Pre Recruitment 2027 will start from 26 September 2026, and candidates can apply until 06 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details of UPSC Engineering Services Pre Recruitment 2027 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 26 September 2026
  • Last Date : 06 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 October 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 31 January 2027
  • Mains Exam Date : 18 June 2027
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, SC, Female, PH : 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPSC Engineering Services Pre Online Form 2027?

UPSC Engineering Services Pre Online Form 2027 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
